import itertools
rows = data_rows('Allowed assignments', {'L': 'string', 'M': 'string', 'N': 'number'}, start_row=812, end_row=820)
data = [cells('Allowed assignments', f'L{r}:N{r}')[0] for r in rows]
tasks = list(set(x[0] for x in data))
workers = list(set(x[1] for x in data))
cost_map = {(x[0], x[1]): x[2] for x in data}
avail_workers = [w for w in workers if w != 'Dune']
min_cost = float('inf')
for p in itertools.permutations(avail_workers, len(tasks)):
    valid = True
    c = 0
    for t, w in zip(tasks, p):
        if (t, w) not in cost_map:
            valid = False
            break
        c += cost_map[(t, w)]
    if valid:
        min_cost = min(min_cost, c)
result = min_cost
